source.explanation: The authoring backend writes metadata.data directly as the w3a data pointer; 0 is for non-Data fields,1 is DataA,2 is DataB, etc. Names and translations are omitted from this derived structural reference.

AIno.reason: Orb of Slow added in Warcraft2.0.2; pointer/type/level metadata is checked by field ID, but base-specific compatibility is not covered by the1.32.8 snapshot.
